bilangan-subnet: Choose the number or IPv4 subnet tab.
Enter a number and its base, or an IPv4 address with a CIDR prefix or mask.
Check and copy the result. Subnet splitting is limited to 256 rows to keep your browser responsive.
code-to-image: Paste code, then choose its language for syntax highlighting.
Adjust the theme, padding, and corners until the image looks right.
Download PNG when the size and colors are right.
cron: Fill in five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, and day of week. Use * for all values.
Choose a time zone. Upcoming runs are calculated in that zone.
Copy the cron expression after checking its explanation and next five runs.
curl-ke-kode: Paste one curl command, including the headers and data you need.
Choose Fetch or Axios, then convert. Read the warnings about flags, files, and browser limitations.
Copy the code and replace file or variable placeholders before running it yourself.
diagram: Choose a template above the editor, then edit its code. The preview updates with it.
Syntax errors point to the line that needs attention.
Download PNG or SVG once the diagram is valid.
Visual Editor opens diagrams.net inside this page. Use Save & Exit there to download a .drawio file.
draw: Draw on the canvas as usual. Changes are saved automatically in this browser.
Change the filename above the canvas, then download PNG, SVG, or .excalidraw.
Copy image copies a PNG to your clipboard, ready to paste into a document or chat.
The canvas follows the site theme and updates when you change it.
format-kode: Paste your code, then choose a language and SQL dialect if needed.
Choose indentation and SQL keyword style, then press Format or Minify for JSON and CSS.
Copy or download the result with the extension for your chosen language.
generator: Markdown: write on the left; the preview updates with you. The toolbar inserts bold, italic, headings, lists, code, links, and tables.
README: fill in the form on the left; the preview appears on the right. Copy .md and Download .md are above the preview.
JSON: paste text, then press Format or Minify. Errors include a line and column.
Convert: switch between JSON ↔ CSV and JSON ↔ YAML. The first CSV row is treated as column headers.
.gitignore: check the stacks you use, then copy or download the file.
License: choose a type, enter the copyright holder, then copy or download LICENSE.
hapus-exif: Choose a JPG or PNG. Your original photo is not uploaded anywhere.
Detected metadata is removed, then the before and after sizes are shown.
Download the result. Pixel data is not changed or recompressed.
hash: Choose Text or File mode, then enter the content.
Choose an algorithm. The hash is calculated in this tab.
Paste a comparison hash to check whether it matches, then copy the result.
json-schema: Paste a schema and JSON data into the two panels.
Choose a schema draft, then press Validate. Results also update as you type.
Fix the data using the issue list. Each issue includes its path and reason.
kalkulator-ipk: Choose your university's grading scale. Each grade weight can be adjusted from 0 to 4.
Add semesters and courses, then enter credits and letter grades.
Check your semester GPA, cumulative GPA, or target GPA. Export JSON for a backup and import it to restore.
kirim-file: Choose files, set an expiry, and optionally enable a password or one-time download for each file.
Press Upload and create link, then copy the link or show its QR code to the recipient.
Files and links are deleted automatically at expiry. With one-time download, each file can only be retrieved once.
Files over 8 MB upload in chunks. If the connection drops, press Retry upload to continue from the last chunk.
Keep the management link to view downloads and delete the transfer early. Reopen it from Your transfers in this browser.
kompres-gambar: Choose a JPG, PNG, or WebP. The preview and original size appear immediately.
Adjust the output format, quality, and maximum dimensions. The result updates automatically.
Download the result when its size and dimensions are right.
mock-data: Set the number of rows, seed, and fields you need.
Press Generate data. The same seed always produces the same data.
Copy or download the result as JSON or CSV.
pas-foto: Choose a portrait. The background-removal model downloads once, then stays cached in your browser.
Choose a background color and print size. Adjust zoom, brightness, and edge smoothing as needed.
Download a 300 DPI PNG or JPG, then check its print dimensions before printing.
Print sheets arrange multiple copies on 4R or A4 paper. Print without scaling at 300 DPI.
pdf: Merge: choose two or more PDFs, arrange them with ▲ ▼, then download.
Split: choose one PDF, enter pages such as 1-3,5, then download.
Compress: choose a PDF and compression level. Before and after sizes are shown.
Images → PDF: choose JPG or PNG files, set orientation and margins, then download.
PDF → Images: choose PNG or JPG and a resolution, then download each page.
Rotate & remove: rotate pages by 90°, remove unwanted pages, then save.
prompt: Search or filter by category, AI, and level. Filters are stored in the URL so you can share them.
Open a prompt, fill in its variables, and watch the final preview update as you type.
Copy the result or download a .md file. No field values are sent to a server.
qr: Type text or paste a URL into the input. The preview appears immediately.
Adjust size, error correction, and margin for print or screen use.
Download PNG for an image, or SVG to scale it without losing quality.
sitasi: Choose a style and source type. Enter each author's first and last names separately.
Fill in the source details, then add it to the list. Check the preview and example in-text citation.
Copy one or all citations, download text, or export BibTeX. The list is saved in your browser.
tabel-latex: Paste a Markdown, CSV, or TSV table. The first row becomes the header.
Adjust rules, caption, label, and columns while checking the preview.
Copy or download .tex. Choose the reverse direction to convert a simple tabular environment to Markdown.
teks: Paste text on the left. Character, word, line, and sentence counts update immediately.
Choose a transformation button to fill in the result on the right.
Use Fill lorem to insert sample text and populate the result, then copy or download.
utilitas: Base64 and URL: paste text, then press Encode or Decode. You can copy the result.
JWT: paste a token to read its header and payload immediately. The signature is not verified.
UUID: set an amount from 1 to 50, then press Generate UUID.
Timestamp: enter seconds, milliseconds, or a date, then press Convert.
Regex: enter a pattern and test text. Matches are highlighted and listed with positions and groups.
Diff: enter old and new text. Added and removed lines are marked with line numbers.
warna: Choose text and background colors with the pickers or enter HEX values directly.
Check the contrast ratio and AA/AAA status for normal and large text.
Click a color in the derived palette to copy its HEX value.
